reviews.review: Top down zombies from black ops mixed with tech/research from destiny

Game is pure jank, little more.

Only thing that's polished is sound design and the majority of the graphics, game design is jank with a bunch of progression systems but very little depth, as if their just adding systems that are known to work without the actual understanding what makes them fun, weapon customization is nice but that's a low bar.

The game isn't objectively bad, it's just not objectively great, it doesn't suffer from lack of ammo as upgrading guns give you more ammo then you need and spending merit(which the game gives you far more then you need) on a super weapon that again has more ammo that you need, you only ever need to watch the ammo when fighting bosses. 

Objectively the game is just jank.
